digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate blocking and T10 infra DET overlay
propositions: T3 and T10 criteria are configured with default_posture blocking and block_threshold 0.90 to enforce blocking on high-priority findings after being non-blocking for 2500+ runs

T10 severity guidance restricts MAJOR-class findings to destructive apply, wildcard/overbroad grant, plaintext secrets, and unauthenticated internet services to prevent lower-severity findings from reaching the 0.90 blocking threshold

A DetGateRule named infra-vocabulary is added to det_gate_rules.py with terraform/cloudformation/kubernetes/ansible/IAM/GitHub Actions trigger terms to pre-gate T10 LLM routing on infrastructure-related plans

Two pinned test assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py—the full routing table and the approved blocking set—are updated to reflect T3 and T10 as blocking criteria, plus a third pin in test_impact_model_versioning.py

Unit tests verify that T3 and T10 findings at priority ≥0.90 produce blocking decisions while those <0.90 remain advisory, and that the T10 DET gate fires on terraform and GitHub Actions fixtures but skips non-infra plans
